# Site covariates (soil pH, texture, aridity)

Extracts gridded soil properties (SoilGrids 250 m, 0 cm) and the aridity index
(Global-AI v3) at each site. These columns (PH_0, SAND_0, CLAY_0, AI) are already
included in `data/SoilHealthDB_V2_CC.csv`, so this chunk is not evaluated by default.
Raster sources:

- SoilGrids 250 m: https://github.com/ISRICWorldSoil/SoilGrids250m
- Global Aridity Index v3: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.7504448

```{r covariates, eval=FALSE}
SH <- read.csv("data/SoilHealthDB_V2_CC.csv", header = TRUE,
               fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = c("", "NA"))

# SoilGrids, 0 cm depth
ph_0   <- terra::rast("data/soilgrids/PHIHOX_M_sl1_250m_ll.tif")
sand_0 <- terra::rast("data/soilgrids/SNDPPT_M_sl1_250m_ll.tif")
clay_0 <- terra::rast("data/soilgrids/CLYPPT_M_sl1_250m_ll.tif")

pts_sg <- terra::vect(SH, geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = terra::crs(ph_0))
soil_0 <- terra::extract(c(ph_0, sand_0, clay_0), pts_sg, ID = FALSE)
colnames(soil_0) <- c("PH_0", "SAND_0", "CLAY_0")
soil_0$PH_0 <- soil_0$PH_0 * 0.1          # pH stored as pH x 10

# Aridity index
ai <- terra::rast("data/Global-AI_ET0_annual_v3/ai_v3_yr.tif")
pts_ai <- terra::vect(SH, geom = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = terra::crs(ai))
ai_ext <- terra::extract(ai, pts_ai, ID = FALSE)
colnames(ai_ext) <- "AI"
ai_ext$AI <- ai_ext$AI * 0.0001           # AI stored as AI x 10000

covariates <- cbind(SH[, c("StudyID", "Latitude", "Longitude")], soil_0, ai_ext)
write.csv(covariates, "data/site_covariates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


# Figure 1. Site map

```{r figure1}
# The data file contains cover crop (CC) observations only
SHDB_CC <- read.csv("data/SoilHealthDB_V2_CC.csv",
                    header = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = c("", "NA"))

# Number of observations per site (point size capped at 75 observations)
siteInfor_CC <- SHDB_CC %>% dplyr::select(Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude)) %>% group_by(Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  tally() %>% mutate(N = ifelse(n >= 75, 75, n), var_size = mean(N) * 0.5 + N * 0.05)

n_obs_CC   <- nrow(SHDB_CC)
n_study_CC <- n_distinct(SHDB_CC$StudyID)

world <- map_data("world", region = ".", exact = FALSE)

sitemap <- ggplot(world, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", fill = "gray") +
  geom_point(data = siteInfor_CC,
             aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = var_size),
             inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 1, col = "#2ECC71", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(x = -178, y = -40), aes(x = x, y = y),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 1, col = "#2ECC71", size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = -170, y = -40,
           label = paste0("Cover crops (", n_obs_CC, "/", n_study_CC, ")"),
           size = 4, hjust = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude", breaks = seq(-180, 180, 30)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude",  breaks = seq(-60, 90, 20), limits = c(-60, 90)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
print(sitemap)

ggsave("outputs/Figure 1.jpg", plot = sitemap, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("outputs/Figure 1.pdf", plot = sitemap, width = 9, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# Figure 2. Overall effect sizes

```{r figure2}
# Indicator categories and colours
group_list <- list(
  "Physical properties"      = c("BD","Aggregate","Porosity","SWC","Penetration"),
  "Chemical properties" = c("OC","N","P","K","pH"),
  "Biological properties"    = c("SoilFauna","Fungal","Enzyme","Nmineralization"),
  "Crop productivity"        = c("BiomassCash","Yield"),
  "Environmental impacts"    = c("Weed","Erosion","Leaching"),
  "Greenhouse gas emissions" = c("N2O","CO2","CH4"))

group_colors <- c("Physical properties"="#E07B6A","Chemical properties"="#E8A950",
                  "Biological properties"="#4BADB5","Crop productivity"="#9B7EC8",
                  "Environmental impacts"="#5E81AC","Greenhouse gas emissions"="#EC9BBC")

assign_group <- function(ind){ for(g in names(group_list)) if(ind %in% group_list[[g]]) return(g); "Other" }
# Display labels used in figures (internal names follow database column names)
disp_lab <- c(OC="SOC", Nmineralization="Nmin", BiomassCash="Biomass",
              N2O="N\u2082O", CO2="CO\u2082", CH4="CH\u2084")
lab_of <- function(x){ x <- as.character(x); ifelse(x %in% names(disp_lab), disp_lab[x], x) }

# The data file contains cover crop (CC) observations only
SHDB_CC <- read.csv("data/SoilHealthDB_V2_CC.csv",
                    header=TRUE, fileEncoding="UTF-8", na=c("","NA"))

# CO2 cleaning: CO2 records from laboratory incubations and composite GHG
# metrics (CO2 equivalents / GHGI / GWP) are excluded
co2_cmt_col <- intersect(c("X40CO2_Comments","40CO2_Comments"), colnames(SHDB_CC))[1]
stopifnot("CO2 comments column not found" = !is.na(co2_cmt_col))

bio_pat <- paste(
  "basal respiration", "microbial respiration", "substrate.?induced",
  "from incubation",   "incubation respiration", "anaerobic incubation",
  "respiratory rate",  "soil microbial",
  "qco2",              "metabolic quotient",
  "\\bvial",           "headspace", "sealed jar", "jar incubat",
  sep = "|")
ghgi_pat <- "CO2 equivalent|\\bGHGI\\b|\\bGWP\\b"

is_bio_co2  <- !is.na(SHDB_CC[[co2_cmt_col]]) &
               grepl(bio_pat,  SHDB_CC[[co2_cmt_col]], perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
is_ghgi_co2 <- !is.na(SHDB_CC[[co2_cmt_col]]) &
               grepl(ghgi_pat, SHDB_CC[[co2_cmt_col]], perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
is_drop_co2 <- is_bio_co2 | is_ghgi_co2

SHDB_CC[is_drop_co2, c("CO2_C","CO2_T","CO2_C_SD","CO2_T_SD")] <- NA

# Background columns and the 22 indicators (each indicator: _C, _T, _C_SD, _T_SD)
background_name <- c(
  "StudyID","Latitude","Longitude","Start_year","Sampling_year",
  "CCMiddleGroup","CC_Termination_method","CC_return_method",
  "No_C","No_T","PH_0","SAND_0","CLAY_0","AI")
indicators <- c("BiomassCash_C","Yield_C","BD_C","OC_C","N_C","P_C","K_C","pH_C",
                "Aggregate_C","Porosity_C","Penetration_C","Erosion_C","Leaching_C","SWC_C",
                "Weed_C","SoilFauna_C","Fungal_C","Enzyme_C","Nmineralization_C","N2O_C","CO2_C","CH4_C")

response_name <- unlist(lapply(indicators, function(ind){
  cp <- which(colnames(SHDB_CC)==ind); colnames(SHDB_CC)[cp:(cp+3)] }))
data_all <- SHDB_CC %>% select(any_of(c(background_name, response_name)))
bg <- intersect(background_name, colnames(data_all))

resp_cols <- intersect(response_name, colnames(data_all))
data_all <- data_all %>% mutate(across(all_of(resp_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))

# Global median CV, used as fallback for missing SD imputation
get_cv <- function(sd, m){ sd<-as.numeric(sd); m<-as.numeric(m); r<-sd/m; median(r[is.finite(r)&m>0], na.rm=TRUE) }
stack <- do.call(rbind, lapply(indicators, function(ind){
  cp <- which(colnames(data_all)==ind)
  data.frame(m=data_all[[cp]], s=data_all[[cp+2]], mt=data_all[[cp+1]], st=data_all[[cp+3]]) }))
cvC_global <- get_cv(stack$s, stack$m); cvT_global <- get_cv(stack$st, stack$mt)

# lnRR and multilevel random-effects model (random = ~1 | StudyID) for each indicator
results_all <- data.frame(); effect_data_list <- list()

for (ind in indicators) {
  cp <- which(colnames(data_all)==ind)
  ed <- data_all %>% select(all_of(bg), all_of(colnames(data_all)[cp:(cp+3)]))
  colnames(ed)[(length(bg)+1):ncol(ed)] <- c("C_mean","T_mean","C_SD","T_SD")
  lab <- substr(ind, 1, nchar(ind)-2)

  ed$No_C <- as.numeric(ed$No_C); ed$No_T <- as.numeric(ed$No_T)
  ed <- ed %>% filter(!is.na(C_mean), !is.na(T_mean), !is.na(No_C), !is.na(No_T), C_mean>0, T_mean>0)
  if (nrow(ed) < 3) next

  # Impute missing SD as mean x median CV of the same indicator
  cvC <- get_cv(ed$C_SD, ed$C_mean); if (!is.finite(cvC)) cvC <- cvC_global
  cvT <- get_cv(ed$T_SD, ed$T_mean); if (!is.finite(cvT)) cvT <- cvT_global
  n_pre <- nrow(ed); n_imp <- sum(is.na(ed$C_SD)) + sum(is.na(ed$T_SD))
  ed <- ed %>% mutate(C_SD=ifelse(is.na(C_SD), C_mean*cvC, C_SD),
                      T_SD=ifelse(is.na(T_SD), T_mean*cvT, T_SD))

  es <- escalc(measure="ROM", m1i=T_mean, sd1i=T_SD, n1i=No_T,
                              m2i=C_mean, sd2i=C_SD, n2i=No_C, data=ed)
  es <- es %>% filter(is.finite(yi), is.finite(vi), vi>0)
  if (nrow(es) < 3) next
  effect_data_list[[lab]] <- es

  fit <- tryCatch(rma.mv(yi=yi, V=vi, random=~1|StudyID, data=es, method="REML", sparse=TRUE),
                  error=function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  est <- as.numeric(fit$b)[1]; cil <- fit$ci.lb; ciu <- fit$ci.ub; pv <- fit$pval[1]
  wts <- 1/es$vi; sdP <- sum(wts) - sum(wts^2)/sum(wts)
  I2 <- 100 * sum(fit$sigma2) / (sum(fit$sigma2) + (fit$k - fit$p)/sdP)

  results_all <- bind_rows(results_all, data.frame(
    Indicator=lab, LnRR_mean=est, CI_lower=cil, CI_upper=ciu,
    Pct_mean=(exp(est)-1)*100, Pct_lower=(exp(cil)-1)*100, Pct_upper=(exp(ciu)-1)*100,
    P_value=pv, N_obs=nrow(es), N_study=length(unique(es$StudyID)),
    N_imputed_SD=n_imp, Pct_imputed=round(100*n_imp/(2*n_pre),1),
    I2=round(I2,1), QE=round(fit$QE,1), QE_p=fit$QEp))
}

# Summary table
results_summary <- results_all %>%
  mutate(Group=factor(sapply(Indicator, assign_group), levels=names(group_list)),
         Indicator=factor(Indicator, levels=unlist(group_list))) %>%
  arrange(Group, Indicator) %>%
  mutate(Sig=case_when(P_value<.001~"***",P_value<.01~"**",P_value<.05~"*",P_value<.10~"marginal",TRUE~"ns"),
         Effect_pct=sprintf("%.1f%%",Pct_mean), CI_95=sprintf("(%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",Pct_lower,Pct_upper),
         P_value_fmt=ifelse(P_value<.001,"<0.001",sprintf("%.3f",P_value)),
         Sample=paste0(N_obs,"/",N_study), I2=paste0(I2,"%"), Imputed=paste0(Pct_imputed,"%")) %>%
  select(Group, Indicator, Effect_pct, CI_95, P_value_fmt, Sig, Sample, I2, Imputed)
print(as.data.frame(results_summary))

# Forest plot
results_plot <- results_all %>% filter(Indicator %in% unlist(group_list)) %>%
  mutate(Group=factor(sapply(Indicator, assign_group), levels=names(group_list)),
         Significant=ifelse(CI_lower>0 | CI_upper<0,"yes","no"),
         Point_fill=ifelse(Significant=="yes", sapply(Indicator, assign_group), "white"),
         Indicator=factor(Indicator, levels=rev(unlist(group_list))))
panel_labels <- setNames(paste0("(",letters[seq_along(names(group_list))],") ",names(group_list)), names(group_list))

p <- ggplot(results_plot, aes(Pct_mean, Indicator, color=Group)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=Pct_lower, xmax=Pct_upper), height=.3, linewidth=.9) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=Point_fill), shape=21, size=5, stroke=1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray50", linewidth=.7) +
  geom_text(aes(x=Inf, label=paste0(N_obs,"/",N_study)), hjust=1.15, size=7, color="black") +
  scale_color_manual(values=group_colors) + scale_fill_manual(values=c(group_colors,"white"="white")) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, nrow=2, ncol=3, scales="free", labeller=labeller(Group=panel_labels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(.05,.45))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels=lab_of) +
  theme_classic(base_size=28) +
  theme(plot.title=element_blank(),
        strip.background=element_rect(fill="gray95",color="black",linewidth=1.2),
        strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=22), axis.text.y=element_text(size=22),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=20), axis.title.x=element_text(size=24),
        axis.title.y=element_blank(), legend.position="none",
        panel.spacing=unit(.8,"lines"), panel.border=element_rect(color="black",fill=NA,linewidth=1.2),
        panel.grid=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_line(color="black",linewidth=1.0), axis.line=element_blank()) +
  labs(x="Mean effect size (%)", y=NULL)
print(p)
ggsave("outputs/Figure 2.pdf", p, width=20, height=14, dpi=300)
ggsave("outputs/Figure 2.jpg", p, width=20, height=14, dpi=300)
```


# Moderator classification

```{r moderators}
# Cover crop type
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(CC_type = case_when(
    CCMiddleGroup %in% c("Legume","legume")                      ~ "Legume",
    CCMiddleGroup %in% c("Grass","grass","Rye","rye")            ~ "Grass",
    CCMiddleGroup %in% c("Brassicaceae","brassicaceae","Broadleaf") ~ "Broadleaf",
    CCMiddleGroup %in% c("Mixed","Other","weed","MTT","MOT","MMT",
                         "natural vegetation","AVG","GG","LG","LGG",
                         "LGB","LB","BG","BGL","BL","LL")         ~ "MMT",
    is.na(CCMiddleGroup)                                          ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                          ~ "Other"))

# Termination method
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(CC_termination_first = word(CC_Termination_method, 1),
         CC_termination = case_when(
    CC_termination_first %in% c("Mechanical","mowing","Roller","disking",
      "Mechanical（Mulched）","Disked","rolling","Harvested","Disk","Slashing",
      "plowing","Mechanical,crushed","Mowed","mechanical,stalk","Sweep","Manual",
      "Plowing","Chopper","mowed","Mowing","mechanical","plow")    ~ "Physical",
    CC_termination_first %in% c("Chemical","Glyphosate","glyphosate",
      "Herbicide(Glyphosate)","Herbicide","herbicide","Herbicides","Herbicide,",
      "Herbicide(Glyphosate),","paraquat","Herbicide(Glyphosate,","Dicamba") ~ "Chemical",
    CC_termination_first %in% c("Biological","Natural")            ~ "Biological",
    CC_termination_first %in% c("Integrated","Integrated(mix",
      "Mechanical/Chemical","Mechanical,Chemical")                 ~ "Integrated",
    is.na(CC_Termination_method)                                   ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                           ~ "Other"))

# Residue return method
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(CC_return = case_when(
    CC_return_method %in% c("surface","Surface")           ~ "Surface",
    CC_return_method %in% c("Incorporated","incorporated") ~ "Incorporated",
    CC_return_method %in% c("Removed","removed")           ~ "Removed",
    is.na(CC_return_method)                                ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE                                                   ~ "Other"))

# Experiment duration
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(Years_calc = ifelse(!is.na(Sampling_year) & !is.na(Start_year),
                             as.numeric(Sampling_year) - as.numeric(Start_year), NA_real_),
         Duration_group = case_when(
           is.na(Years_calc) | Years_calc < 0 ~ NA_character_,
           Years_calc <= 4                    ~ "short (0–4 yr)",
           Years_calc <= 9                    ~ "medium (5–9 yr)",
           Years_calc >= 10                   ~ "long (≥ 10 yr)",
           TRUE                               ~ NA_character_),
         Duration_group = factor(Duration_group,
           levels = c("short (0–4 yr)","medium (5–9 yr)","long (≥ 10 yr)")))

# Aridity (AI < 0.65 = dry)
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(AI_group = case_when(is.na(AI) ~ NA_character_,
                              AI <  0.65 ~ "Dry",
                              AI >= 0.65 ~ "Humid"),
         AI_group = factor(AI_group, levels = c("Dry","Humid")))

# Soil texture from SoilGrids sand and clay (%)
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(Texture_group = case_when(
    is.na(SAND_0) | is.na(CLAY_0)                  ~ NA_character_,
    SAND_0 >= 70                & CLAY_0 < 15      ~ "Coarse",
    SAND_0 >= 50 & SAND_0 < 70  & CLAY_0 < 20      ~ "Coarse",
    CLAY_0 >= 40                                   ~ "Fine",
    CLAY_0 >= 27 & CLAY_0 < 40                     ~ "Fine",
    TRUE                                           ~ "Medium"),
    Texture_group = factor(Texture_group, levels = c("Coarse","Medium","Fine")))

# Soil pH from SoilGrids
data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(pH_group = case_when(
    is.na(PH_0)  ~ NA_character_,
    PH_0 <  6.5  ~ "Acidic (<6.5)",
    PH_0 <= 7.5  ~ "Neutral (6.5–7.5)",
    PH_0 >  7.5  ~ "Alkaline (>7.5)"),
    pH_group = factor(pH_group,
      levels = c("Acidic (<6.5)","Neutral (6.5–7.5)","Alkaline (>7.5)")))
```


# Subgroup analysis functions

```{r subgroup-engine}
# Build effect sizes for one indicator (SD imputation + lnRR), same as Figure 2
build_es <- function(ind, extra_cols = character(0), df = data_all) {
  cp <- which(colnames(df) == ind); if (length(cp)==0) return(NULL)
  keep_bg <- intersect(background_name, colnames(df))
  ed <- df %>% select(all_of(keep_bg),
                      all_of(colnames(df)[cp:(cp+3)]),
                      all_of(intersect(extra_cols, colnames(df))))
  colnames(ed)[(length(keep_bg)+1):(length(keep_bg)+4)] <- c("C_mean","T_mean","C_SD","T_SD")
  ed <- ed %>%
    mutate(across(c(C_mean,T_mean,C_SD,T_SD,No_C,No_T), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(C_mean), !is.na(T_mean), !is.na(No_C), !is.na(No_T), C_mean>0, T_mean>0)
  if (nrow(ed) < 3) return(NULL)
  cvC <- get_cv(ed$C_SD, ed$C_mean); if (!is.finite(cvC)) cvC <- cvC_global
  cvT <- get_cv(ed$T_SD, ed$T_mean); if (!is.finite(cvT)) cvT <- cvT_global
  ed <- ed %>% mutate(is_imp = is.na(C_SD) | is.na(T_SD),
                      C_SD = ifelse(is.na(C_SD), C_mean*cvC, C_SD),
                      T_SD = ifelse(is.na(T_SD), T_mean*cvT, T_SD))
  es <- escalc(measure="ROM", m1i=T_mean, sd1i=T_SD, n1i=No_T,
                              m2i=C_mean, sd2i=C_SD, n2i=No_C, data=ed)
  es <- es %>% filter(is.finite(yi), is.finite(vi), vi>0)
  if (nrow(es) < 3) return(NULL)
  es
}

MIN_N_TOTAL <- 10; MIN_N_STUDY <- 3

# Subgroup estimates (separate model per level) and between-group test (QM)
run_analysis <- function(mod_config, indicators, df = data_all,
                          min_total_sg = MIN_N_TOTAL,
                          min_study_sg = MIN_N_STUDY,
                          min_total_qb = 30) {
  mod_names <- names(mod_config)
  sg_list   <- list(); skip_list <- list(); qb_list <- list()

  for (ind in indicators) {
    es <- build_es(ind, extra_cols = mod_names, df = df)
    if (is.null(es)) next
    lab <- substr(ind, 1, nchar(ind)-2)

    # Subgroup estimates
    for (mod in mod_names) for (lvl in mod_config[[mod]]) {
      sub <- es[!is.na(es[[mod]]) & as.character(es[[mod]]) == lvl, , drop=FALSE]
      n_t <- nrow(sub); n_s <- length(unique(sub$StudyID))
      if (n_t < min_total_sg || n_s < min_study_sg) {
        skip_list[[length(skip_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
          Indicator=lab, Moderator=mod, Level=lvl,
          N_total=n_t, N_study=n_s,
          Reason=ifelse(n_t<min_total_sg,"too few observations","too few studies"))
        next
      }
      fit <- tryCatch(
        rma.mv(yi, V=vi, random=~1|StudyID, data=sub, method="REML", sparse=TRUE),
        error=function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fit)) next
      est<-as.numeric(fit$b)[1]; cl<-fit$ci.lb; cu<-fit$ci.ub; pv<-fit$pval[1]
      sg_list[[length(sg_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
        Indicator=lab, Moderator=mod, Level=lvl,
        Estimate=est, CI_lower=cl, CI_upper=cu,
        Pct_mean=(exp(est)-1)*100, Pct_lower=(exp(cl)-1)*100, Pct_upper=(exp(cu)-1)*100,
        P_value=pv, N_total=n_t, N_study=n_s,
        Significant=ifelse(cl>0|cu<0,"yes","no"),
        Sig=case_when(pv<.001~"***",pv<.01~"**",pv<.05~"*",pv<.1~".",TRUE~"ns"))
    }

    # Between-group omnibus test (meta-regression, mods = ~moderator)
    for (mod in mod_names) {
      sub <- es[!is.na(es[[mod]]) &
                as.character(es[[mod]]) %in% mod_config[[mod]], , drop=FALSE]
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
      sub$gvar <- droplevels(factor(as.character(sub[[mod]]), levels=mod_config[[mod]]))
      if (nlevels(sub$gvar) < 2 || nrow(sub) < min_total_qb) next
      fit <- tryCatch(
        rma.mv(yi, V=vi, mods=~gvar, random=~1|StudyID, data=sub,
               method="REML", sparse=TRUE),
        error=function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fit)) next
      pb <- fit$QMp
      qb_list[[length(qb_list)+1]] <- data.frame(
        Indicator=lab, Moderator=mod, N_total=nrow(sub),
        N_levels=nlevels(sub$gvar), QM=as.numeric(fit$QM), P_between=pb,
        Sig_between=case_when(pb<.001~"***",pb<.01~"**",pb<.05~"*",pb<.1~".",TRUE~"ns"))
    }
  }

  list(results = if (length(sg_list))   bind_rows(sg_list)   else data.frame(),
       skipped = if (length(skip_list)) bind_rows(skip_list) else data.frame(),
       between = if (length(qb_list))   bind_rows(qb_list)   else data.frame())
}
```

# Plotting functions for Figures 3–6

```{r subgroup-plot-functions}
# Top panel: distribution of individual lnRR and the pooled estimate (diamond)
plot_lnrr_top <- function(indicator_name, data_all, ind_color, show_y_axis = TRUE) {
  col_C <- paste0(indicator_name, "_C")
  if (!col_C %in% colnames(data_all)) return(ggplot()+theme_void())
  es <- build_es(col_C, df = data_all)
  if (is.null(es) || nrow(es)==0) return(ggplot()+theme_void())

  fit <- tryCatch(rma.mv(yi, V=vi, random=~1|StudyID, data=es, method="REML", sparse=TRUE),
                  error=function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) { mean_lnrr <- weighted.mean(es$yi, 1/es$vi, na.rm=TRUE); pval <- NA }
  else { mean_lnrr <- as.numeric(fit$b)[1]; pval <- fit$pval[1] }
  mean_pct  <- (exp(mean_lnrr)-1)*100
  sig_label <- case_when(is.na(pval)~"", pval<.001~"***", pval<.01~"**",
                         pval<.05~"*", TRUE~"ns")

  dat_sorted <- es %>% transmute(LnRR=yi, se=sqrt(vi)) %>% arrange(LnRR) %>%
    mutate(rank=row_number(), ci_low=LnRR-1.96*se, ci_high=LnRR+1.96*se)
  n_total <- nrow(dat_sorted); y_lim <- c(-1,1)

  ggplot(dat_sorted, aes(rank, LnRR)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(ci_low, y_lim[1]*1.2), ymax=pmin(ci_high, y_lim[2]*1.2)),
                  width=0, color=ind_color, alpha=0.18, linewidth=0.3, na.rm=TRUE) +
    geom_point(color=ind_color, size=0.4, alpha=0.55) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray40", linewidth=0.4) +
    annotate("point", x=n_total/2, y=mean_lnrr, color=ind_color, fill=ind_color,
             size=5, shape=23) +
    annotate("text", x=n_total/2, y=mean_lnrr, label=sprintf("%+.1f%%", mean_pct),
             vjust=-1.3, size=5.5, fontface="bold", color="black") +
    annotate("text", x=n_total/2, y=y_lim[2]*0.92, label=sig_label, size=7, fontface="bold") +
    annotate("text", x=n_total/2, y=y_lim[1]*0.92, label=sprintf("italic(n) == %d", n_total),
             parse=TRUE, size=5, color="black") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=y_lim) +
    labs(x=NULL, y=if (show_y_axis) "lnRR" else NULL, title=lab_of(indicator_name)) +
    theme_classic(base_size=14) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_blank(), axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), axis.line.x=element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = if (show_y_axis) element_text(size=16) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= if (show_y_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
          axis.line=element_blank(),
          axis.title.y= if (show_y_axis) element_text(size=16, margin=margin(r=-3)) else element_blank(),
          panel.border=element_rect(color="black", fill=NA, linewidth=0.7),
          plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=22),
          plot.margin=margin(8,10,4,10))
}

# Forest plot of subgroup estimates for one indicator
plot_forest_indicator <- function(indicator_name, results_sg, results_het,
                                   mod_display, mod_labels, x_limit=NULL, show_y_axis=TRUE) {
  pd_raw <- results_sg %>% filter(Indicator==indicator_name, !is.na(Pct_mean))
  if (nrow(pd_raw)==0) return(ggplot()+theme_void())

  total_rows <- 0; mod_info <- list()
  for (mod in names(mod_display)) { lvls <- mod_display[[mod]]; mod_info[[mod]] <- lvls
    total_rows <- total_rows + length(lvls) }

  row_df <- data.frame(); sep_y <- c(); current_row <- total_rows; first_mod <- TRUE
  for (mod in names(mod_info)) {
    lvls <- mod_info[[mod]]
    if (!first_mod) { sep_y <- c(sep_y, current_row + 0.5); current_row <- current_row - 0.5 }
    first_mod <- FALSE
    for (lvl in lvls) {
      row_df <- bind_rows(row_df, data.frame(Moderator=mod, Level=lvl,
                row_pos=current_row, stringsAsFactors=FALSE))
      current_row <- current_row - 1 }
  }

  pd <- row_df %>% left_join(pd_raw, by=c("Moderator","Level")) %>%
    mutate(Indicator=indicator_name)
  if (nrow(results_het) > 0)
    pd <- pd %>% left_join(results_het %>% select(Indicator, Moderator, P_between),
                           by=c("Indicator","Moderator"))
  else pd$P_between <- NA_real_

  pd <- pd %>% mutate(Significant=ifelse(CI_lower>0 | CI_upper<0,"yes","no"),
                      ind_color=group_colors[sapply(Indicator, assign_group)],
                      point_fill=ifelse(Significant=="yes", ind_color, "white"))
  ind_color <- unique(pd$ind_color)[1]

  if (is.null(x_limit)) {
    x_max <- max(abs(c(pd$Pct_lower, pd$Pct_upper)), na.rm=TRUE)
    x_max <- ceiling(x_max/10)*10; x_limit <- c(-x_max, x_max) }
  x_limit_plot <- c(x_limit[1], x_limit[2]*1.60)

  # Moderator label with between-group significance: (*) p < 0.05, ns otherwise
  mod_label_df <- pd %>% group_by(Moderator) %>%
    summarise(y_label=max(row_pos)+0.5, P_between=first(P_between), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(p_label=case_when(is.na(P_between)~"", P_between<0.05~"*", TRUE~"ns"),
           mod_text=paste0(mod_labels[Moderator],
                           ifelse(p_label!="", paste0("  (", p_label, ")"), "")))

  p <- ggplot(pd, aes(Pct_mean, row_pos)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray50", linewidth=0.5) +
    {if (length(sep_y)>0) geom_hline(yintercept=sep_y, linetype="dashed",
                                     color="gray70", linewidth=0.4)} +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin=pmax(Pct_lower, x_limit[1]), xmax=pmin(Pct_upper, x_limit[2])),
                   height=0.35, linewidth=0.9, color=ind_color, na.rm=TRUE) +
    geom_point(aes(fill=point_fill), shape=21, size=4, stroke=1.6, color=ind_color, na.rm=TRUE) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    geom_text(data=function(d) filter(d, !is.na(N_total)),
              aes(x=x_limit_plot[2], label=paste0(N_total,"/",N_study)),
              hjust=1.05, size=5, color="black") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=x_limit_plot, clip="off") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=scales::pretty_breaks()(x_limit),
                       expand=expansion(mult=c(0.02,0.02))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=pd$row_pos,
                       labels=ifelse(pd$Level=="MMT","Mixed", pd$Level),
                       limits=c(min(pd$row_pos)-0.3, max(pd$row_pos)+0.7), expand=c(0,0)) +
    labs(x=NULL, y=NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size=16) +
    theme(axis.title.y=element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = if (show_y_axis) element_text(size=16) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= if (show_y_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
          axis.text.x =element_text(size=14), axis.line=element_blank(),
          panel.border=element_rect(color="black", fill=NA, linewidth=0.7),
          plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=22),
          plot.margin=margin(t=4, r=10, b=4, l=5))
  p + geom_text(data=mod_label_df, aes(x=x_limit[1], y=y_label, label=mod_text),
                hjust=0, vjust=0.5, size=16/.pt, fontface="plain",
                color="black", inherit.aes=FALSE)
}

# One indicator panel (optional lnRR distribution on top of the forest plot)
make_indicator_panel <- function(indicator_name, data_all, results_sg, results_het,
                                 mod_display, mod_labels, panel_label=NULL,
                                 show_y_axis=TRUE, show_lnrr_top=TRUE) {
  ind_color <- group_colors[assign_group(indicator_name)]
  p_forest <- plot_forest_indicator(indicator_name, results_sg, results_het,
                                     mod_display, mod_labels, show_y_axis=show_y_axis)
  if (show_lnrr_top) {
    p_top <- plot_lnrr_top(indicator_name, data_all, ind_color, show_y_axis)
    if (!is.null(panel_label)) {
      tag_x <- if (show_y_axis) 0.25 else 0.02
      p_top <- p_top + labs(tag=panel_label) +
        theme(plot.tag=element_text(face="bold", size=20), plot.tag.position=c(tag_x, 0.93)) }
    return(p_top / p_forest + plot_layout(heights=c(1, 3.5)))
  } else {
    p_forest <- p_forest + labs(title=lab_of(indicator_name))
    if (!is.null(panel_label)) {
      tag_x <- if (show_y_axis) 0.30 else 0.02
      p_forest <- p_forest + labs(tag=panel_label) +
        theme(plot.tag=element_text(face="bold", size=20), plot.tag.position=c(tag_x, 0.97)) }
    return(p_forest)
  }
}

# Multi-panel figure
make_figure <- function(indicator_names, data_all, results_sg, results_het,
                        mod_display, mod_labels, panel_widths=NULL, show_lnrr_top=TRUE) {
  tags <- paste0("(", letters[seq_along(indicator_names)], ")")
  panels <- lapply(seq_along(indicator_names), function(i)
    make_indicator_panel(indicator_names[i], data_all, results_sg, results_het,
                         mod_display, mod_labels, panel_label=tags[i],
                         show_y_axis=(i==1), show_lnrr_top=show_lnrr_top))
  if (is.null(panel_widths)) panel_widths <- rep(1, length(indicator_names))
  wrap_plots(panels, nrow=1, widths=panel_widths) +
    plot_annotation(caption="Mean effect size (%)",
      theme=theme(plot.caption=element_text(hjust=0.5, size=18, color="black",
                                            margin=margin(t=10, b=4))))
}
```

# Figure S1. Publication bias

```{r figureS1}
# Funnel plots and Egger's test, using observations with reported SD only
# and trimming extreme standard errors (> median + 6 x MAD)
real_sd_only  <- TRUE
TRIM_OUTLIERS <- TRUE
TRIM_MAD      <- 6

ind_order <- unlist(group_list)
ind_order <- ind_order[paste0(ind_order, "_C") %in% colnames(data_all)]

get_es <- function(ind){
  es <- build_es(paste0(ind, "_C"))
  if (is.null(es)) return(NULL)
  if (real_sd_only && "is_imp" %in% names(es)) es <- es[!es$is_imp, , drop=FALSE]
  if (nrow(es) == 0) return(es)
  if (TRIM_OUTLIERS) {
    se   <- sqrt(es$vi)
    madv <- mad(se, na.rm=TRUE)
    cap  <- median(se, na.rm=TRUE) + TRIM_MAD * madv
    if (!is.finite(cap) || madv == 0) cap <- max(se, na.rm=TRUE)
    es <- es[se <= cap, , drop=FALSE]
  }
  es
}

# Keep indicators with at least 5 studies
ind_keep <- ind_order[sapply(ind_order, function(ind){
  e <- get_es(ind)
  !is.null(e) && length(unique(e$StudyID)) >= 5 })]

funnel_pts <- bind_rows(lapply(ind_keep, function(ind){
  es <- get_es(ind)
  data.frame(Indicator=ind, yi=es$yi, se=sqrt(es$vi)) }))

# Pseudo 95% confidence limits around zero
funnel_band <- bind_rows(lapply(ind_keep, function(ind){
  se_max <- max(sqrt(get_es(ind)$vi), na.rm=TRUE)
  s <- seq(0, se_max, length.out=100); center <- 0
  data.frame(Indicator=ind, se=s, lwr=center-1.96*s, upr=center+1.96*s) }))

lev <- ind_keep
funnel_pts$Indicator  <- factor(funnel_pts$Indicator,  levels=lev)
funnel_band$Indicator <- factor(funnel_band$Indicator, levels=lev)
panel_labels <- setNames(paste0("(", letters[seq_along(lev)], ") ", lab_of(lev)), lev)

pf <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=funnel_band, aes(x=lwr, y=se), linetype="dashed", color="grey55", linewidth=.6) +
  geom_line(data=funnel_band, aes(x=upr, y=se), linetype="dashed", color="grey55", linewidth=.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, color="grey35", linewidth=.6) +
  geom_point(data=funnel_pts, aes(x=yi, y=se),
             shape=21, size=2.8, stroke=.5, color="black", fill="grey70", alpha=.75) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~Indicator, scales="free", labeller=labeller(Indicator=panel_labels)) +
  theme_classic(base_size=20) +
  theme(strip.background=element_rect(fill="grey92", color="black", linewidth=1.0),
        strip.text=element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x=element_text(size=11),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16), legend.position="none",
        panel.spacing=unit(.6,"lines"),
        panel.border=element_rect(color="black", fill=NA, linewidth=1.0),
        panel.grid=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks=element_line(color="black", linewidth=.8), axis.line=element_blank()) +
  labs(x="Log ratio of means (LnRR)", y="Standard error")
print(pf)
ggsave("outputs/Figure S1.pdf", pf, width=18, height=12, dpi=300)
ggsave("outputs/Figure S1.jpg", pf, width=18, height=12, dpi=300)

# Egger's regression test (multilevel, moderator = SE)
bias_results <- data.frame()
for (ind in ind_keep){
  es  <- get_es(ind)
  egg <- tryCatch(rma.mv(yi=yi, V=vi, mods=~sqrt(vi), random=~1|StudyID,
                         data=es, method="REML", sparse=TRUE), error=function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(egg)) next
  bias_results <- bind_rows(bias_results, data.frame(
    Indicator=ind, N_obs=nrow(es), N_study=length(unique(es$StudyID)),
    Egger_slope=egg$b[2], Egger_p=egg$pval[2],
    Asymmetry=ifelse(egg$pval[2] < .05, "yes", "no"))) }
bias_results <- bias_results %>%
  mutate(Egger_p_fmt=ifelse(Egger_p<.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", Egger_p)))
print(bias_results)
```


# Figure 7a. Correlation heatmap (study level)

```{r figure7a}
heatmap_indicators <- c("BD","Aggregate","SWC","Penetration",
                        "OC","N","P","pH",
                        "Enzyme","Nmineralization","Yield")
ind_group <- c(
  BD="Physical properties",Aggregate="Physical properties", SWC="Physical properties", Penetration="Physical properties",
  OC="Chemical properties", N="Chemical properties", P="Chemical properties",
  pH="Chemical properties",
  Enzyme="Biological properties", Nmineralization="Biological properties",
  Yield="Crop productivity")
ind_order <- heatmap_indicators
group_colors_axis <- c("Physical properties"="#E07B6A","Chemical properties"="#E8A950",
                       "Biological properties"="#4BADB5","Crop productivity"="#9B7EC8")

# Observation-level lnRR
lnrr_long <- data.frame()
for (ind in paste0(heatmap_indicators, "_C")) {
  if (!ind %in% colnames(data_all)) next
  cp <- which(colnames(data_all) == ind)
  tmp <- data_all %>%
    select(StudyID, all_of(colnames(data_all)[cp:(cp+3)])) %>%
    setNames(c("StudyID","C_mean","T_mean","C_SD","T_SD")) %>%
    mutate(across(c(C_mean,T_mean), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(C_mean), !is.na(T_mean), C_mean>0, T_mean>0) %>%
    mutate(LnRR = log(T_mean/C_mean), Indicator = substr(ind,1,nchar(ind)-2)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(LnRR)) %>%
    select(StudyID, Indicator, LnRR)
  lnrr_long <- bind_rows(lnrr_long, tmp)
}

# Study-level mean lnRR for each indicator
lnrr_wide <- lnrr_long %>%
  group_by(StudyID, Indicator) %>%
  summarise(LnRR = mean(LnRR, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Indicator, values_from=LnRR) %>%
  select(StudyID, any_of(ind_order))

# Pairwise Pearson correlations (n_pair = number of paired studies)
ind_available <- ind_order[ind_order %in% colnames(lnrr_wide)]
mat <- lnrr_wide %>% select(all_of(ind_available)) %>% as.matrix()
n_ind <- length(ind_available)
cor_mat   <- matrix(NA, n_ind, n_ind, dimnames=list(ind_available, ind_available))
pval_mat  <- matrix(NA, n_ind, n_ind, dimnames=list(ind_available, ind_available))
npair_mat <- matrix(0L, n_ind, n_ind, dimnames=list(ind_available, ind_available))
for (i in seq_len(n_ind)) for (j in seq_len(n_ind)) {
  x <- mat[,i]; y <- mat[,j]; valid <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); np <- sum(valid)
  npair_mat[i,j] <- np
  if (i==j) { cor_mat[i,j] <- 1; pval_mat[i,j] <- 0; next }
  if (np >= 3) { ct <- cor.test(x[valid], y[valid], method="pearson")
                 cor_mat[i,j] <- ct$estimate; pval_mat[i,j] <- ct$p.value }
}

# Lower-triangle long format
cor_df <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>% mutate(Var1=ind_available) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Var1, names_to="Var2", values_to="r") %>%
  left_join(as.data.frame(pval_mat) %>% mutate(Var1=ind_available) %>%
              pivot_longer(-Var1, names_to="Var2", values_to="pval"), by=c("Var1","Var2")) %>%
  left_join(as.data.frame(npair_mat) %>% mutate(Var1=ind_available) %>%
              pivot_longer(-Var1, names_to="Var2", values_to="n_pair"), by=c("Var1","Var2")) %>%
  mutate(sig_label=case_when(Var1==Var2~"", is.na(pval)~"", pval<0.001~"***",
                             pval<0.01~"**", pval<0.05~"*", TRUE~""),
         is_diag=(Var1==Var2),
         i_idx=match(Var1, rev(ind_available)), j_idx=match(Var2, ind_available),
         Var1=factor(Var1, levels=rev(ind_available)),
         Var2=factor(Var2, levels=ind_available)) %>%
  filter(i_idx + j_idx <= n_ind + 1)

axis_colors_x <- group_colors_axis[ind_group[ind_available]]
axis_colors_y <- group_colors_axis[ind_group[rev(ind_available)]]

n <- n_ind
p_heat <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var2, Var1)) +
  geom_tile(data=cor_df %>% filter(!is_diag), aes(fill=r), color="white", linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_tile(data=cor_df %>% filter(is_diag), fill="gray92", color="white", linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_text(data=cor_df %>% filter(!is_diag, !is.na(r), sig_label!=""),
            aes(label=sig_label), size=4.5, vjust=0.8, color="black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="#2166AC", mid="#F5EFE3", high="#D6604D", midpoint=0,
                       limits=c(-1,1), na.value=NA, name="Pearson r",
                       guide=guide_colorbar(barwidth=1.2, barheight=10, title.position="top")) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits=ind_available, labels=lab_of) + scale_y_discrete(limits=rev(ind_available), labels=lab_of) +
  annotate("segment", x=0.5, xend=0.5, y=0.5, yend=n+0.5, color="black", linewidth=0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x=0.5, xend=n+0.5, y=0.5, yend=0.5, color="black", linewidth=0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x=seq(0.5,n-0.5), xend=seq(1.5,n+0.5),
           y=seq(n+0.5,1.5), yend=seq(n+0.5,1.5), color="black", linewidth=0.8) +
  annotate("segment", x=seq(1.5,n+0.5), xend=seq(1.5,n+0.5),
           y=seq(n+0.5,1.5), yend=seq(n-0.5,0.5), color="black", linewidth=0.8) +
  coord_fixed() + theme_minimal(base_size=13) +

        axis.title=element_blank(), panel.grid=element_blank(),

        plot.margin=margin(10,10,10,10))
p_heat <- p_heat +

print(p_heat)
```

# Figure 7. Correlation network (study level)

```{r figure7}
nodes_net <- data.frame(name=ind_available,
                        group=unname(ind_group[ind_available]), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
idx <- which(upper.tri(cor_mat), arr.ind=TRUE)
edges_all <- data.frame(from=rownames(cor_mat)[idx[,1]], to=colnames(cor_mat)[idx[,2]],
                        r=cor_mat[idx], pval=pval_mat[idx], n_pair=npair_mat[idx],
                        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
group_colors_net <- group_colors_axis

# Edges: |r| >= 0.2, p < 0.05 and at least 5 paired studies
R_THRESHOLD <- 0.2; P_THRESHOLD <- 0.05; N_THRESHOLD <- 5
edges_filtered <- edges_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(r), !is.na(pval), abs(r)>=R_THRESHOLD, pval<P_THRESHOLD, n_pair>=N_THRESHOLD) %>%
  mutate(edge_type=factor(ifelse(r>0,"Positive","Negative"), levels=c("Positive","Negative")),
         weight=abs(r))

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d=edges_filtered %>% select(from,to,weight,r,pval,edge_type,n_pair),
  vertices=nodes_net, directed=FALSE)
V(g)$degree      <- degree(g)
V(g)$strength    <- strength(g, weights=E(g)$weight)   # node strength = sum of |r|

# Louvain community detection
set.seed(123)
communities <- cluster_louvain(g, weights=E(g)$weight)
V(g)$module <- as.character(membership(communities))

node_stats <- data.frame(Indicator=V(g)$name, Group=V(g)$group, Module=V(g)$module,
  Degree=V(g)$degree, Strength=round(V(g)$strength,3)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>% arrange(desc(Strength))
print(as.data.frame(node_stats))

mods <- sort(unique(V(g)$module))
pal_mod <- c("#222222","#888888","#C9A227","#3B7A57","#7B5EA7","#B5651D")
module_stroke_colors <- setNames(pal_mod[seq_along(mods)], mods)
g_tidy <- as_tbl_graph(g)

set.seed(42)
p_net <- ggraph(g_tidy, layout="stress") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width=weight, edge_color=edge_type, edge_alpha=weight)) +
  scale_edge_width(range=c(0.5,3.2), name="|r|", breaks=c(0.2,0.4,0.6)) +
  scale_edge_alpha(range=c(0.4,0.9), guide="none") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values=c(Positive="#D6604D", Negative="#2166AC"),
                          name="Correlation", drop=FALSE) +
  geom_node_point(aes(size=strength, fill=group, color=module), shape=21, stroke=2.2) +
  scale_size_continuous(range=c(8,18), name="Strength", breaks=pretty(V(g)$strength, n=4)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=group_colors_net, name="Function group") +
  scale_color_manual(values=module_stroke_colors, name="Module") +
  geom_node_text(aes(label=lab_of(name)), size=4.5, fontface="bold", color="black") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.18,0.18))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.12,0.12))) +
  theme_void(base_size=13) + theme(legend.position="none", plot.margin=margin(10,10,10,10))

# Inset bar chart of node strength
node_stats_plot <- node_stats %>%
  mutate(Indicator = factor(Indicator, levels = Indicator[order(Strength)]))
yc <- group_colors_net[node_stats_plot$Group[order(node_stats_plot$Strength)]]

p_bar_inset <- ggplot(node_stats_plot, aes(Strength, Indicator)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Group), width = 0.72, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Strength)),
            hjust = -0.18, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", color = "grey30") +

        axis.text.x     = element_blank(),

        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),

p_b <- p_net +

# Combine (a) heatmap and (b) network
```

# Figure 8. Soil health index (AHP weighting)

```{r figure8}
cat_to_long <- c(
  Physical    = "Physical properties",
  Chemical    = "Chemical properties",
  Biological  = "Biological properties",
  Crop        = "Crop productivity",
  Environment = "Environmental impacts",
  GHG         = "Greenhouse gas emissions")

# Indicator orientation: positive = higher is better, negative = lower is better.
# pH is oriented by baseline pH class (see below).
negative_indicators <- c("BD","Penetration","Erosion","Leaching","Weed","N2O","CH4","CO2")
ph_lo <- 6.5; ph_hi <- 7.5

# AHP weights from 10 expert questionnaires (row geometric mean per questionnaire,
# aggregated by arithmetic mean of individual priorities; all CR <= 0.1).
# Pairwise comparison matrices are given in Supplementary Excel S1.
categories <- c("Physical", "Chemical", "Biological", "Crop", "Environment", "GHG")

# Criterion layer (6 categories)
cat_weights <- c(Physical = 0.164985, Chemical    = 0.152570, Biological = 0.211857,
                 Crop     = 0.276622, Environment = 0.104521, GHG        = 0.089444)

# Indicator layer (within each category)
phys_inds <- c("BD", "Aggregate", "Porosity", "SWC", "Penetration")
phys_w    <- c(0.202382, 0.339620, 0.146336, 0.205754, 0.105907)

chem_inds <- c("OC", "N", "P", "K", "pH")
chem_w    <- c(0.405648, 0.191921, 0.117007, 0.092618, 0.192807)

bio_inds  <- c("SoilFauna", "Fungal", "Enzyme", "Nmineralization")
bio_w     <- c(0.226699, 0.251373, 0.305401, 0.216527)

crop_inds <- c("BiomassCash", "Yield")
crop_w    <- c(0.385238, 0.614762)

env_inds  <- c("Weed", "Erosion", "Leaching")
env_w     <- c(0.237677, 0.432794, 0.329529)

ghg_inds  <- c("N2O", "CO2", "CH4")
ghg_w     <- c(0.393764, 0.326376, 0.279859)

# Consistency ratio range across the 10 questionnaires
# (the 2 x 2 crop matrix is always consistent)
ahp_CR_range <- data.frame(
  Level   = c("Criteria", "Physical", "Chemical", "Biological",
              "Crop", "Environment", "GHG"),
  n_items = c(6, 5, 5, 4, 2, 3, 3),
  CR_min  = c(0.0412, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000),
  CR_max  = c(0.0997, 0.0962, 0.0981, 0.0965, 0.0000, 0.0739, 0.0930))

# Normalise each layer to sum to 1
names(phys_w) <- phys_inds; names(chem_w) <- chem_inds; names(bio_w)  <- bio_inds
names(crop_w) <- crop_inds; names(env_w)  <- env_inds;  names(ghg_w)  <- ghg_inds
cat_weights <- cat_weights / sum(cat_weights)
phys_w <- phys_w/sum(phys_w); chem_w <- chem_w/sum(chem_w); bio_w  <- bio_w /sum(bio_w)
crop_w <- crop_w/sum(crop_w); env_w  <- env_w /sum(env_w);  ghg_w  <- ghg_w /sum(ghg_w)

# Global weight = category weight x indicator weight
make_global <- function(cn, lw, in_) data.frame(Indicator = in_, Category = cn,
                          AHP_Global = as.numeric(cat_weights[cn] * lw))
ahp_global <- bind_rows(
  make_global("Physical",    phys_w, phys_inds),
  make_global("Chemical",    chem_w, chem_inds),
  make_global("Biological",  bio_w,  bio_inds),
  make_global("Crop",        crop_w, crop_inds),
  make_global("Environment", env_w,  env_inds),
  make_global("GHG",         ghg_w,  ghg_inds))
combined <- ahp_global %>% mutate(Combined_Weight = AHP_Global/sum(AHP_Global)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Combined_Weight))
print(as.data.frame(combined))

# Pooled effect for one indicator (multilevel model, with fallbacks for small samples)
meta_estimate <- function(ind_C, df) {
  es <- build_es(ind_C, df=df)
  if (is.null(es)) return(data.frame(est=NA_real_, lo=NA_real_, hi=NA_real_,
                                     n_obs=0L, n_study=0L, method="none"))
  n_obs<-nrow(es); n_study<-length(unique(es$StudyID))
  fit <- if (n_study>=2) tryCatch(rma.mv(yi, V=vi, random=~1|StudyID, data=es,
                          method="REML", sparse=TRUE), error=function(e) NULL) else NULL
  if (!is.null(fit))
    return(data.frame(est=as.numeric(fit$b)[1], lo=fit$ci.lb, hi=fit$ci.ub,
                      n_obs=n_obs, n_study=n_study, method="rma.mv"))
  ff <- tryCatch(rma(yi, vi, data=es, method="FE"), error=function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ff))
    return(data.frame(est=as.numeric(ff$b)[1], lo=ff$ci.lb, hi=ff$ci.ub,
                      n_obs=n_obs, n_study=n_study, method="FE"))
  w<-1/es$vi; e<-sum(es$yi*w)/sum(w); s<-sqrt(1/sum(w))
  data.frame(est=e, lo=e-1.96*s, hi=e+1.96*s, n_obs=n_obs, n_study=n_study, method="wmean")
}

# pH orientation by baseline (control) pH: increase is beneficial in acidic soils (< 6.5),
# detrimental in alkaline soils (> 7.5) and neutral otherwise
build_pH_strat <- function(df, ph_lo=6.5, ph_hi=7.5) {
  cp <- which(colnames(df)=="pH_C")
  ed <- data.frame(StudyID = df[["StudyID"]],
                   No_C = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[["No_C"]])),
                   No_T = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[["No_T"]])),
                   C_mean = df[[cp]],   T_mean = df[[cp+1]],
                   C_SD   = df[[cp+2]], T_SD   = df[[cp+3]]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(C_mean),!is.na(T_mean),!is.na(No_C),!is.na(No_T),C_mean>0,T_mean>0)
  cvC <- get_cv(ed$C_SD, ed$C_mean); if(!is.finite(cvC)) cvC <- cvC_global
  cvT <- get_cv(ed$T_SD, ed$T_mean); if(!is.finite(cvT)) cvT <- cvT_global
  ed <- ed %>% mutate(C_SD=ifelse(is.na(C_SD), C_mean*cvC, C_SD),
                      T_SD=ifelse(is.na(T_SD), T_mean*cvT, T_SD))
  es <- escalc(measure="ROM", m1i=T_mean, sd1i=T_SD, n1i=No_T,
                              m2i=C_mean, sd2i=C_SD, n2i=No_C, data=ed)
  es %>% filter(is.finite(yi), is.finite(vi), vi>0) %>%
    mutate(pH_group = case_when(C_mean <  ph_lo ~ "acidic",
                                C_mean >  ph_hi ~ "alkaline",
                                TRUE            ~ "neutral"))
}
pool_es <- function(es) {
  if (is.null(es) || nrow(es)==0) return(list(est=NA_real_,lo=NA_real_,hi=NA_real_,n=0L,k=0L,method="none"))
  n<-nrow(es); k<-length(unique(es$StudyID))
  fit <- if(k>=2) tryCatch(rma.mv(yi,V=vi,random=~1|StudyID,data=es,method="REML",sparse=TRUE),error=function(e)NULL) else NULL
  if(!is.null(fit)) return(list(est=as.numeric(fit$b)[1],lo=fit$ci.lb,hi=fit$ci.ub,n=n,k=k,method="rma.mv"))
  ff <- tryCatch(rma(yi,vi,data=es,method="FE"),error=function(e)NULL)
  if(!is.null(ff)) return(list(est=as.numeric(ff$b)[1],lo=ff$ci.lb,hi=ff$ci.ub,n=n,k=k,method="FE"))
  w<-1/es$vi; e<-sum(es$yi*w)/sum(w); s<-sqrt(1/sum(w))
  list(est=e,lo=e-1.96*s,hi=e+1.96*s,n=n,k=k,method="wmean")
}
compute_pH_SHI <- function(df, ph_lo=6.5, ph_hi=7.5) {
  es <- build_pH_strat(df, ph_lo, ph_hi)
  N  <- nrow(es)
  sign_map <- c(acidic=1, neutral=0, alkaline=-1)
  sub <- bind_rows(lapply(c("acidic","neutral","alkaline"), function(g){
    p   <- pool_es(es %>% filter(pH_group==g))
    pct <- (exp(p$est)-1)*100
    lo  <- if(!is.na(p$lo)) (exp(p$lo)-1)*100 else NA_real_
    hi  <- if(!is.na(p$hi)) (exp(p$hi)-1)*100 else NA_real_
    se  <- if(!is.na(lo)) (hi-lo)/(2*1.96) else NA_real_
    data.frame(pH_group=g, n_obs=p$n, n_study=p$k, Method=p$method,
               Raw_pct=pct, Raw_lo=lo, Raw_hi=hi, se_pct=se, Sign=sign_map[[g]])
  }))
  # Combine classes weighted by their share of observations
  sub$w            <- if (N>0) sub$n_obs/N else 0
  sub$Oriented_pct <- sub$Sign * sub$Raw_pct
  sub$Contrib_pct  <- sub$w * sub$Oriented_pct
  valid <- !is.na(sub$Raw_pct)
  oriented_pct <- sum(sub$Contrib_pct[valid], na.rm=TRUE)
  se_or        <- sqrt(sum((sub$w[valid]*sub$Sign[valid]*sub$se_pct[valid])^2, na.rm=TRUE))
  pall <- pool_es(es)
  list(sub=sub, N=N, oriented_pct=oriented_pct,
       oriented_lo=oriented_pct-1.96*se_or, oriented_hi=oriented_pct+1.96*se_or,
       raw_pct=(exp(pall$est)-1)*100, n_obs=pall$n, n_study=pall$k)
}
ph_result <- compute_pH_SHI(data_all, ph_lo, ph_hi)
print(as.data.frame(ph_result$sub))

# Oriented percentage change for each indicator
meta_all <- list()
for (ind_C in indicators) {
  base <- sub("_C$","",ind_C)
  if (base == "pH") {
    direction <- "pH_baseline"
    raw_pct   <- ph_result$raw_pct
    oriented  <- ph_result$oriented_pct
    o_lo      <- ph_result$oriented_lo; o_hi <- ph_result$oriented_hi
    r <- list(n_obs=ph_result$n_obs, n_study=ph_result$n_study, method="pH_strat")
  } else {
    r <- meta_estimate(ind_C, data_all)
    raw_pct <- (exp(r$est)-1)*100
    if (!is.na(r$lo)) { lo<-(exp(r$lo)-1)*100; hi<-(exp(r$hi)-1)*100 } else { lo<-NA_real_; hi<-NA_real_ }
    if (base %in% negative_indicators) {
      direction <- "negative"; oriented <- -raw_pct; o_lo <- -hi; o_hi <- -lo
    } else {
      direction <- "positive"; oriented <- raw_pct;  o_lo <- lo;  o_hi <- hi
    }
  }
  meta_all[[length(meta_all)+1]] <- data.frame(
    Indicator=base, Direction=direction,
    n_obs=r$n_obs, n_study=r$n_study, Method=r$method,
    Raw_pct=raw_pct, Oriented_pct=oriented, Oriented_lo=o_lo, Oriented_hi=o_hi)
}

# Radar chart of category contributions
draw_radar_single <- function(values_pct, fill_color, grid_breaks=NULL) {
  n_cat<-length(values_pct); angles<-seq(pi/2, pi/2-2*pi, length.out=n_cat+1)[1:n_cat]
  if (is.null(grid_breaks)) grid_breaks<-c(0,10,20,30,40)
  v_min <- -4.5; v_max <- max(grid_breaks)
  val_to_r<-function(v)(v-v_min)/(v_max-v_min); r_zero<-val_to_r(0)
  make_hex<-function(r) data.frame(x=r*cos(c(angles,angles[1])), y=r*sin(c(angles,angles[1])))
  grid_df<-do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(grid_breaks), function(i){
    df<-make_hex(val_to_r(grid_breaks[i])); df$grp<-i; df }))
  zero_hex<-make_hex(r_zero)
  spoke_df<-data.frame(x0=val_to_r(v_min)*cos(angles), y0=val_to_r(v_min)*sin(angles),
                       x1=val_to_r(v_max)*cos(angles), y1=val_to_r(v_max)*sin(angles))
  r_data<-val_to_r(values_pct)
  df_plot<-data.frame(Category=categories, value=values_pct, angle=angles,
                      x=r_data*cos(angles), y=r_data*sin(angles))
  df_closed<-bind_rows(df_plot, df_plot[1,])
  short_names<-c(Physical="Physical\nproperties", Chemical="Chemical\nproperties",
                 Biological="Biological\nproperties", Crop="Crop\nproductivity",
                 Environment="Environmental\nimpacts", GHG="Greenhouse\ngas emissions")
  lbl_r<-val_to_r(v_max)*1.20
  label_df <- df_plot %>% mutate(
    full_name = short_names[as.character(Category)],
    val_label = sprintf("(%.2f%%)", value),
    lx = lbl_r*cos(angle), ly = lbl_r*sin(angle),
    ha = case_when(cos(angle)>0.15~0, cos(angle)< -0.15~1, TRUE~0.5),
    va_name = case_when(sin(angle)>0.15~0, sin(angle)< -0.15~1, TRUE~0.5),
    ly_val = ly - 0.34,
    va_val = case_when(sin(angle)>0.15~0, sin(angle)< -0.15~1, TRUE~0.5),
    label_color = unname(group_colors[cat_to_long[as.character(Category)]]))
  tick_df<-data.frame(val=grid_breaks, x=-0.06, y=val_to_r(grid_breaks), lab=paste0(grid_breaks,"%"))
  ggplot() +
    geom_path(data=grid_df, aes(x,y,group=factor(grp)), color="grey82", linewidth=0.45) +
    geom_path(data=zero_hex, aes(x,y), color="grey50", linewidth=0.8) +
    geom_segment(data=spoke_df, aes(x=x0,y=y0,xend=x1,yend=y1), color="grey82", linewidth=0.45) +
    geom_polygon(data=df_closed, aes(x,y), fill=fill_color, alpha=0.25, color=NA) +
    geom_path(data=df_closed, aes(x,y), color=fill_color, linewidth=1.4) +
    geom_point(data=df_plot, aes(x,y), color=fill_color, size=3.2) +
    geom_text(data=tick_df, aes(x,y,label=lab), size=5.0, color="black", hjust=1) +
    geom_text(data=label_df,
              aes(lx,ly,label=full_name,hjust=ha,vjust=va_name,color=label_color),
              size=6.5, fontface="bold", lineheight=0.9) +
    geom_text(data=label_df,
          aes(lx, ly_val, label=val_label, hjust=ha, vjust=va_val),
          size=5.5, color="black") +
    scale_color_identity() +
    annotate("text", x=0, y=-1.95, label=sprintf("Overall soil health: %.2f%%", sum(values_pct)),
             size=6.5, color="black", fontface="bold", hjust=0.5) +
    coord_fixed(xlim=c(-2.1,2.1), ylim=c(-2.15,1.55), clip="off") +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.margin=margin(20,25,20,25))
}
```
